system.description:
You take 20 direct damage. The target recovers the same amount of HP you lost through this skill's effect.

(CR4): The direct damage increases to 30.
(CR8): The direct damage increases to 40.
(CR11): The direct damage increases to 50.

A special skill that puts vitality on the air that circulates in the earth and atmosphere, and takes over the wounds inflicted on the target.
